FormProblem.title: FormProblem
FormProblem.description:
One finding of POST /forms/{id}/validate; `field` is a dotted path into the definition
(`fields.2.question`), null for the form as a whole.

FormSettings.title: FormSettings
FormSettings.description: Wizard choices kept with the form that are not fields.

HourlyOut.title: HourlyOut
HourlyOut.description: Reports per local hour (24 entries, 0 = midnight) for yesterday and today so far.

InvitePreview.title: InvitePreview
InvitePreview.description: What the /invite/[token] page shows before the person accepts.

KeywordTrigger.title: KeywordTrigger
KeywordTrigger.description: The worker's message contains one of these words or phrases (whole words, any case).

MoveIdentityRequest.title: MoveIdentityRequest
MoveIdentityRequest.description: The record made when the worker joined again from their new phone or Telegram account.

NoReplyTrigger.title: NoReplyTrigger
NoReplyTrigger.description: No reply this many hours after the second draft reminder (roadmap 7.1).

OperatingHours.title: OperatingHours
OperatingHours.description: Working days (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday) and hours.

QuietHours.title: QuietHours
QuietHours.description: No reminders to extension workers between `start` and `end` (may cross midnight).

RegionPathOut.title: RegionPathOut
RegionPathOut.description: Where a GPS point falls. Fields are null when the point is outside every boundary.

ReportFieldOut.title: ReportFieldOut
ReportFieldOut.description: One answer, labelled by the structure version the report was made with.

ReportListItemOut.title: ReportListItemOut
ReportListItemOut.description: One row of a report list (dashboard "Laporan terbaru", activity feed, tables).

ReportVoiceOut.title: ReportVoiceOut
ReportVoiceOut.description: The voice note that filled the report (Voice Lab, roadmap 12.3/12.4).

Rule.title: Rule
Rule.description: IF `if.field` equals `if.equals` THEN `then` (JIKA ... MAKA ... in the UI).

UpdateExtensionWorkerRequest.title: UpdateExtensionWorkerRequest
UpdateExtensionWorkerRequest.description: Only the fields sent change. `region_id: null` clears the region.

UpdateFormRequest.title: UpdateFormRequest
UpdateFormRequest.description:
Autosave: only the parts sent change; `definition` and `settings` replace the stored
ones as a whole.

UpdateJoinCodeRequest.title: UpdateJoinCodeRequest
UpdateJoinCodeRequest.description: Only the fields sent change. `max_uses: null` removes the limit.

UpdateWorkspaceRequest.title: UpdateWorkspaceRequest
UpdateWorkspaceRequest.description: Only the fields present change. `operating_hours` / `quiet_hours` set to null clear them.

VoiceSummaryOut.title: VoiceSummaryOut
VoiceSummaryOut.description:
Counts behind the Voice page and an analyst's profile (roadmap 12.4). Days and months
follow the workspace time zone; the client only formats these numbers (B-044).

WorkerTopicOut.title: WorkerTopicOut
WorkerTopicOut.description: The structure the worker asked to join, and the code they used.
